title: Production quantisation against Q8_0
compared: Gemma 4 E4B in the production quantisation UD-IQ2_M against the same model in Q8_0, replaying the production prompts.
sample: Gold jobs with a bug or ticket a person set: public, and internal (all product bugs).
verdict: Level on the public jobs, where Q8_0 trades test issues for product bugs; Q8_0 ahead on the internal product bugs. Inside the noise for a decision on the public set.
